context: Evaluates correct initialization of a Fastify server instance with appropriate options and startup procedure. The candidate must create a server with logging enabled, register a route, and start listening with proper async error handling. Focus is on correct use of the Fastify factory and its options.

checklist.name: Fastify factory options
checklist.description: Creates the Fastify instance with at minimum `{ logger: true }` or equivalent Pino logger configuration

checklist.name: Route registration
checklist.description: Registers the GET /health route using app.get() with an async handler that returns the correct JSON body

checklist.name: listen() options
checklist.description: Calls app.listen() with both port (3000) and host ('0.0.0.0') to bind on all interfaces

checklist.name: Async start pattern
checklist.description: Wraps listen() in an async function and uses await, not a callback-style invocation

checklist.name: Error handling on startup
checklist.description: Catches listen() errors with try/catch (or .catch()), logs the error, and calls process.exit(1)
